subject: Cold Case Advocacy And Open Investigation Podcast
overview: Melanie Perkins McLaughlin discussed her investigative podcast "Open Investigation," her decades-long search for a missing childhood friend, and her advocacy for systemic changes to protect vulnerable children.

items.title: Introduction and local favorites
items.summary: Guest Melanie Perkins McLaughlin introduced her background in child advocacy and identified Amici's as her favorite Medford restaurant for its inclusivity.

items.title: Disappearance of Andy and documentary filmmaking
items.summary: McLaughlin described the 1976 disappearance of her childhood friend, Andy, and her promise to find him which led to the creation of the HBO documentary "Have You Seen Andy?".

items.title: Launch of the Open Investigation podcast
items.summary: The guest discussed using data-driven research in her new podcast to investigate dozens of unsolved cold cases involving missing and murdered children from the 1970s.

items.title: Legislative advocacy and systemic reforms
items.summary: McLaughlin called for a state task force on unsolved cases, a missing persons database, and the elimination of statutes of limitations for crimes involving child sexual abuse.

items.title: Medford Public Schools prevention training
items.summary: The discussion highlighted the successful implementation of a mandatory child abuse prevention and grooming identification curriculum for staff in Medford Public Schools.
